risk_summary: The company reports persistent operating losses, negative operating cash flow, no U.S. product approval, and liquidity sufficient only through the first half of 2015. Continued commercialization and development depend on obtaining additional capital, with failure to do so potentially requiring abandonment of efforts. Disclosure is materially quantified but includes broad contingencies around funding needs, regulatory timing, clinical trials, and commercialization.
